newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine corporate investment up 51 pct in May. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Philippine corporate investment up 51 pct in May. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission reported on Tuesday corporate investments for May jumped by 51 percent to 12.395 billion pesos from 8.209 billion pesos in April.
The latest figure is also a 62.7 percent increase from the May 1995 (corrects from November 1995) figure of 7.616 billion pesos.
"Overall, all local and foreign investors exhibited tremendous enthusiasms investing in newly organised and ongoing business ventures," the SEC report said.
Corporate investments were mainly in the form of cash. Other modes were the conversion of debt and real estate into equity.

The SEC also said new domestic entities in May numbered 1,485, 32.7 percent higher than April's tally of 1,119 new firms, with initial paid-up capital at 2.906 billion pesos from 2.189 billion pesos in April.
